data.name: Maskun
data.gender_notes: Maskun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maskun is a name of Prophet Idris (Enoch) in Arabic language. It is derived from the Arabic word 'maskana' which means 'to send' or 'to convey'. According to Islamic tradition, Prophet Idris was a messenger of Allah and a righteous man. He was given the knowledge of all things and was granted prophethood. The name Maskun carries the meaning “Messenger of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maskun usually hope their child will grow to embody messenger of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Maskun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Messenger of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maskun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
